reason: Directly test dependence of empirical phase contrasts and partition support on the residual assumptions in R3.M4.
data: Same original application participants, preprocessing and training split via checks.prepare_group

conditions.name: Student independent, four degrees of freedom
Student independent, eight degrees of freedom
Student innovations4 with first-order autoregressive working correlation0.2

fixed: all original observations and training masks
original nuisance and phase-effect priors scaled by residual variance
factorial count prior and conditional uniform legal partitions
residual_variance: sigma2 has the same marginal-variance interpretation in every condition; Student variance factor c=(df-2)/df and latent precision w/c.
dependence: Within participant and retained block only; working correlation is coefficient raised to native trial distance, stationary first observation. All response and design columns are whitened.
combined_scope: Independent Student innovations after fixed Gaussian-AR whitening define a proper observed-record working model with covariance sigma2 R; original residual marginals generally are not Student distributions.
sampler: Partially collapsed Gibbs: M,sigma2,delta conditional on weights with nuisance integrated; random nuisance reconstruction; weights conditional on whitened residuals. Recalculate current partition logweight after every weight update.
Gaussian_computation: Exact finite posterior over all27931 partitions; phase-contrast CDF includes K0 point mass atzero.

Student_computation.diagnostic_escalation: Only if maximum monitored Rhat>1.01, minimum nondegenerate bulk/tail ESS<1500, or phase-contrast quantile MCSE>0.002, extend or rerun to30000 iterations under the same fixed seeds and model; report actual warmup and retained counts and do not double-count overlapping draws.

documented_diagnostic_extension.condition: High group, independent Student-t errors with4 degrees of freedom
documented_diagnostic_extension.trigger: At30000 iterations PIP12 bulk/tail ESS1402.05, below1500; remaining criteria passed.
documented_diagnostic_extension.combination: Use extended run alone, not pooled with earlier overlapping draws.
documented_diagnostic_extension.timing: Documented after original protocol and before extension; frozen original protocol retained in study provenance.

metrics: mean effect overbins33-64 minusmean overbins1-32 and95%posterior interval
joint MAP partition and change-count posterior
chain diagnostics and endpoint MCSE where sampled
acceptance: Gaussian independent statistics match original application
weighted statistics match independent full-design calculation
persistent C bridge matches unchanged original kernel

interpretation: Report every condition irrespective of direction; no claim that symmetric Student tails resolve skewness or that finite-grid sensitivity establishes general frequentist coverage. No model is selected using the desired result.
